_comment: Human-verified election calendar. Takes precedence over the auto-discovered
election_calendar.json, which calendar_discovery.py overwrites on every run.
Why this file exists separately: MyNeta's index pages publish only the POLLING
date. Nomination, scrutiny and withdrawal deadlines come from the ECI's own
notification, and eci.gov.in returns 403 to automated requests (verified
2026-07-26, browser User-Agent included). So those dates cannot be scraped
here and are entered by hand from the ECI schedule as carried by PIB and
Getting these four dates right is not bookkeeping. refresh_policy uses them to
separate NOMINATION (affidavits change daily) from CAMPAIGN (candidate field
locked, only news moves). Without them every pre-poll day is treated as
CAMPAIGN, which under-fetches during the one window that actually churns.
myneta_constituency_id values are MyNeta-internal and are NOT the ECI
constituency number - Datia is ECI 22 but MyNeta 234. Each was confirmed by
fetching the page and reading its title.
